method match_parens(lst: seq<string>) returns (result: string)
    requires |lst| == 2 // The input list must contain exactly two strings
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> (lst[i] == "(" || lst[i] == ")") // Each string must consist of only '(' or ')'

method is_good(s: string) returns (b: bool)
    ensures b ==> (count_open(s) == count_close(s)) // A string is good if the count of '(' and ')' are equal
